Cool it, raise its pressure, or flash it first. (on an accelerated guess, broyden, 1400 % of the tear flows beyond the last pass's result; the last pass changed the tears by 1.56e-2. Check the specifications and the start values of the loop first; direct substitution, which never extrapolates, shows whether the guess was the cause). In the last accepted pass the tear streams together gained 39.4 kmol/h of Ethyl acetate (nearly steady for 36 accepted passes in a row): material that keeps accumulating or draining means the products and purges, as specified, do not take what the loop receives (a product given by its flow, a feed in excess of what reacts, a component with no way out); look at the specifications first. What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (S15, S24) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
